text:
rachael: opened PR #5120 to add a tiny "console KV" example and clarify cost/latency pairing in the Console docs. Includes: small dashboard JSON (minimal panel), a tracing-hook compatibility note, and a short PromQL snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120

jose: skimmed. The KV example is useful but the Python snippet assumes `client = RedwoodClient()` from v1; older snippets used different constructor args. Add a short compat line.

frida: Also noticed the dashboard JSON uses a field `targets[0].expr` with the old metric name `console.cost/tokens`. We should standardize to `console_unit_cost_total` and show a one-line jq replace for exported dashboards.

rachael: Good catch. I'll update the JSON and add this jq helper: ```bash
# replace legacy metric in exported dashboards
for f in exported/*.json; do
  jq '(.panels[]?.targets[]?.expr) |= gsub("console.cost/tokens"; "console_unit_cost_total")' "$f" > tmp && mv tmp "$f"
done
```

jose: add a backup suggestion: copy exported/ -> exported-backup/ first, and mention testing import in staging Grafana. Also add a note to null out panel `id` before import to avoid conflicts.

frida: Tracing note: some runtimes prefix trace ids with `0x`. Suggest showing a resilient normalization in snippets: Python `trace_id = trace.id.hex().lstrip('0x')` (or better: conditional strip) and Go `id := strings.TrimPrefix(trace.ID.String(), "0x")`. Add a sentence that sampled=false may omit traces and skew dashboard-attributed costs.

rachael: Added both snippets and the sampling note. Also added PromQL examples: `sum(rate(console_unit_cost_total[5m])) by (service)` and a per-token variant dividing by `sum(rate(token_count_total[5m]))`.

ux-bot: Quick UX note: screenshots need high-contrast borders and accessible alt text. Recommend uploading assets to /assets/images/docs/console/kv-examples/.

assets-bot: uploaded 2 files to /assets/images/docs/console/kv-examples/ (kv-before.png, kv-after.png)

doc-bot: CI: found 1 styling lint (code fence language missing). Linkcheck: 0 broken links. Spelling: 1 suggestion.

jose: fixed fence languages and the spelling. Pushed commit.

doc-bot: Re-run checks... all green. Ready to merge after staging preview.

rachael: queued for staging deploy. Thanks for the quick reviews everyone. Will merge once staging looks match and screenshots render. :shipit:
